title: Plotting with matplotlib
line: Line, scatter and bar charts that read well, saved to a file.

project.title: A four-panel picture of your week
project.brief: Make one figure with four panels on your own from a week of your own numbers, such as sleep, steps and screen time. Use four kinds of plot, label them and save it.
checks: One figure holds four axes, each with a title and axis labels
The panels use a line, a bar, a scatter and a histogram
The figure is saved as a PNG at least 1600 pixels wide

lessons.title: Your first line plot
lessons.goal: Teach matplotlib in Jupyter. Import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, make a figure and axes with plt.subplots and draw a week of temperatures as a line with ax.plot.
lessons.passes: The cell shows one figure whose axes hold one line of seven points.

lessons.title: Titles, labels and a legend
lessons.goal: Teach ax.set_title, ax.set_xlabel, ax.set_ylabel and ax.legend in matplotlib by plotting two cities' temperatures on one chart and labelling everything.
lessons.passes: The chart has a title, both axis labels and a legend with two entries.

lessons.title: Scatter plots
lessons.goal: Teach ax.scatter in matplotlib with the s, c and alpha arguments by plotting hours of sleep against test scores for 50 students.
lessons.passes: The axes hold a scatter of 50 points and both axes are labelled.

lessons.title: Bar charts
lessons.goal: Teach ax.bar and ax.barh in matplotlib by charting the votes for five favourite fruits, sorted from most to fewest.
lessons.passes: The chart has five bars in falling order, each with a fruit name.

lessons.title: Histograms
lessons.goal: Teach ax.hist in matplotlib with the bins argument by showing how the sums of 500 rolls of two dice are spread.
lessons.passes: The histogram has 11 bars, one for each sum from 2 to 12.

lessons.title: Subplots side by side
lessons.goal: Teach plt.subplots with rows and columns in matplotlib by putting a line plot and a bar chart of the same monthly rainfall side by side under one figure title.
lessons.passes: One figure holds two axes in one row and has a figure title.

lessons.title: Colors, markers and line styles
lessons.goal: Teach styling in matplotlib with color, linestyle, marker, linewidth, ax.grid and figsize by restyling the two-city chart so the lines are easy to tell apart.
lessons.passes: The two lines differ in color and line style, and the grid is on.

lessons.title: Point out what matters
lessons.goal: Teach ax.annotate, ax.axhline and ax.text in matplotlib by marking the hottest day on the two-city chart with an arrow and a short note.
lessons.passes: The chart has one annotation with an arrow that points at the highest value.

lessons.title: Save a figure
lessons.goal: Teach fig.savefig in matplotlib with dpi and bbox_inches, and fig.tight_layout, by saving the finished two-city chart as a PNG and a PDF.
lessons.passes: chart.png and chart.pdf exist and the PNG is at least 1000 pixels wide.
